payload.name: Fardeen Ahmad
payload.notes:
Hi Team,

I recently came across the opportunity for the Senior Academics Manager role and found it extremely aligned with my interest in education innovation and large-scale learning impact. The focus on STEM, Coding, AI, and experiential learning within K–12 systems is particularly exciting, especially in the context of NEP 2020 and future-ready education.

With over 5 years of experience in education program management, stakeholder engagement, teacher enablement, and implementation within government school ecosystems, I would be keen to explore how my background could contribute to this role.

I would love to learn more about the position and the team.

Best regards,
Fardeen Ahmad
